description: One OpenAI chat completion through the Langfuse drop-in, with trace-level session, user, tags, and one metadata key.
notes: Langfuse 5.1.0 exports to {base_url}/api/public/otel/v1/traces. base_url is the receiver origin. LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY is capture-public-key and LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY is capture-secret-key. LANGFUSE_MEDIA_UPLOAD_ENABLED is false. LANGFUSE_OTEL_COMPRESSION is none and the client also passes otel_compression none, because the receiver rejects a non-identity content encoding and the SDK default is gzip. There is no separate anonymous-telemetry switch in 5.1.0. The client installs its own tracer provider, so the scenario does not call harness.setup. One span, OpenAI-generation, on scope langfuse-sdk 5.1.0, which also carries public_key. Trace fields are user.id user-1, session.id session-1, langfuse.trace.tags as a string array, and langfuse.trace.metadata.feature as the JSON string "weather". A non-streaming drop-in call does not set completion_start_time. usage_details copies the provider usage object: prompt_tokens 24, completion_tokens 12, total_tokens 36, prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens 8, and completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens 3. Those are the provider field names. model.parameters records the SDK defaults, and max_tokens is the string Infinity.
